biggest_catch: SheerID is an identity-verification vendor used by other brands' student programs — it offers no student discount or benefit of its own to verify.
catches: SheerID's business is verifying student/military/teacher status on behalf of client brands (e.g., it powers Spotify's student verification).
There is no SheerID student discount, price, or savings offer — nothing a student 'gets' from SheerID directly.
The user's student bar requires a concrete live official offer with exact discount/price and expiry — SheerID has no offer at all.
Rejected: verification vendor, not a student benefit.

c1.evidence: SheerID is a real company (identity verification) on the official sheerid.com domain.

c2.evidence: No student offer of any kind exists — it is a B2B verification service.

eligibility: Not applicable — no student benefit is offered.
notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22: SheerID provides eligibility verification infrastructure to brands; it is not itself a student discount program. Rejected as not a student benefit.

s1.note: No consumer offer; nothing to be eligible for.
